from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssets(BaseModel):
    """Extraction of company asset data from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose financials are reported")
    total_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Current Assets value in USD")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for the financial report, e.g. 'March 31, 2024'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_assets: list[CompanyAssets]
